def_en: 1) to prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able
1a1) to be able, be able to gain or accomplish, be able to endure, be able to reach
1a2) to prevail, prevail over or against, overcome, be victor
kjv: be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, (-not)), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.
expl: to be able, literally (can, could) or morally (may, might)
